description.describe_ch: Learning the fundamental concepts and frameworks of innovation is just as important as getting hands-on experience. This course will cover the basic concepts of innovation, basic theories, and representative practical cases. Topics will include, but are not limited to, types of innovation, design thinking, business models, and social innovation. The purpose is to equip attendants with basic innovation tools, while having a preliminary experience with these tools through the course project. The project also aims to draw attendants’ attention to creating social impact through innovation.

targets.describe_ch:
識別並理解漸進性與顛覆性創新的特徵。
理解不同的創新過程。
發展對關鍵社會挑戰的全球視野。
學習有效運用設計研究方法與工具。
發展分析創新專案的可取性、可行性及可持續性的能力。
與團隊成員及創新利益相關者有效合作。
清楚傳達創新專案的理論基礎。
targets.describe_en:
Recognise and understand the characteristics of incremental and radical innovation.
Comprehend different innovation processes. 
Develop a global perspective of critical social challenges. 
Learn to effectively employ design research methods and tools. 
Develop an ability to analyse the desirability, feasibility and viability of a proposed innovation. 
Collaborate effectively with team members and innovation stakeholders. 
Clearly communicate the rationale for a proposed innovation project.
